title: Controlled LLM Re-test: FULL_RAPHAEL vs NO_LLM under Reliable Provider
research_question: Does FULL_RAPHAEL with a reliable LLM provider outperform NO_LLM on LLM-engaging scenarios?
hypothesis: UNDIRECTED — This is an evaluation, not a confirmation. The result may show FULL better, NO_LLM better, or no effect.
seed_source: VALIDATION (not holdout). This preserves holdout integrity per Rule 34.
justification_for_seed_source: SENTINEL GLM-5.2 approved validation seeds for this re-test. The 630-episode holdout remains pristine for post-diagnosis evaluation.

templates.rationale: Falsification engages LLM for discriminator proposal. D-6C holdout showed FULL score=0.33 vs NO_PLANNER score=0.67 in this template; LLM component active but score depressed.
World Model identity requires LLM to identify correct host matching. D-6C holdout showed FULL score=0.00 (GIGO pattern) vs NO_PLANNER score=0.50.
Explicitly LLM-sensitive template. D-6C holdout showed FULL score=0.00 vs NO_PLANNER score=0.33.

rationale_for_architectures.FULL_RAPHAEL: Test architecture with full LLM integration
rationale_for_architectures.NO_LLM: Ablation without LLM — isolates LLM contribution
rationale_for_architectures.LLM_ONLY: LLM without other cognitive components — measures standalone LLM value (D-6C showed 40 FULL wins vs LLM_ONLY)

provider_requirements.success_definition: LLM call returns valid SemanticInference within timeout (no 503, no timeout, no connection error)
provider_requirements.verification_procedure: Before any episode: send 5 test prompts. If ≥4/5 succeed (≥80%), proceed. After every 10 episodes: send 1 test prompt. If any test fails, pause and report.
provider_requirements.fallback_if_provider_unavailable: If no provider achieves ≥90% success rate after 3 attempts, abort the re-test and file a PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE finding. Do not substitute a lower-reliability provider.

provider_options: TBD — any provider that achieves ≥90% call success rate during verification. Options include but are not limited to: NVIDIA NIM (deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash) if reliability improves, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, local inference.
evaluation_metrics: LLM call success rate (must be ≥90% for valid experiment)
FULL vs NO_LLM paired score delta
FULL vs LLM_ONLY paired score delta

acceptance_criteria.experiment_valid: LLM call success rate ≥90% across all 45 episodes
acceptance_criteria.finding_llm_helps: FULL score > NO_LLM score in ≥60% of paired comparisons
acceptance_criteria.finding_llm_hurts: NO_LLM score > FULL score in ≥60% of paired comparisons

stop_conditions: If LLM call success rate drops below 80% at any point → STOP, file PROVIDER_CONFOUNDED
If any prohibited external action is observed → STOP, file SAFETY_FAILURE
If any isolation leak is detected → STOP, file LEAK
prohibited_actions: No modification to any cognitive component before, during, or after this re-test
No rerunning of individual episodes that fail due to provider issues
No comparison of results to D-6C holdout (different seed sets, not comparable)
No claim that this re-test supersedes D-6C — it is a supplementary diagnostic
authorized_work: Execute provider canary phase only. Freeze provider identity before executing 45 episodes.
